questions.question: Dr. Mourad, now a national reference in HR management, is invited to an international congress. What message should he carry?
options: HR management is a model of performance and well-being
HR management is reserved for specialists
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'HR management is a model of performance and well-being for practices.' Dr. Sidki: 'I am proud of you.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki must create a foundation to promote dental HR management. What is the main objective?
options: Promote performance and well-being at work
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Promoting performance and well-being at work is essential for the future of the profession.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will support this foundation.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must write a reference book on dental HR management. What is the central message?
options: HR management is an exact science
HR management is an art that combines performance and humanity
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'HR management is an art that combines performance and humanity.' Dr. Sidki: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki must give a closing speech at an international congress. What note should she leave?
options: HR management is evolving, full of opportunities
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'HR management is evolving, and opportunities are numerous for those who engage.' Dr. Mourad: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must create a mentoring program in HR management. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Mentoring transmits fundamental HR skills.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will support this program.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki must manage the succession of her practice. What is the best strategy?
options: Gradually prepare the transmission of skills
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Gradual preparation of the transmission of skills is the key to a successful succession.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will help you.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must create an HR charter for dental practices. What is the fundamental pillar?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Team performance and well-being are the pillars of any HR charter.' Dr. Sidki: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki must train future HR mentors. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission
Mentoring is a source of income

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must prepare a testimony on his HR journey. What is the most striking element?

questions.question: Dr. Sidki must create an alumni association in HR management. What is the main objective?

questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Mutual support and the link are the driving forces of an alumni association in HR management.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will support this association.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must write an article on the future of dental HR management. What trend should be highlighted?

questions.question: Dr. Sidki must create an HR quality label for practices. What are the main criteria?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Team performance and well-being are the fundamental criteria.' Dr. Mourad: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must give a farewell speech to the profession. What message should he leave?
options: The profession needs HR management enthusiasts
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'The profession needs HR management enthusiasts.' Dr. Sidki: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki must create an award for young dentists in HR management. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Excellence in HR management is the driving force of the profession's evolution.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will support this award.'

questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'The passion for HR management and leadership is the common thread of a professional life.' Dr. Sidki: 'I agree.'
